calendar.matters:
ORDER TO SHOW CAUSE FOR CHANGE OF NAME
Off Calendar Apr-24-2012 Granted Per Written Order
MINI MINUTES: This cause came on regularly as scheduled this day for OSC hearing for Change of Name of a two minors.
Dept. 514, Judge: Donald Sullivan, Clerk: S. Ravinantapricha, CSR: Sonia Wong, #11288
Petitioner Zhen Di Wu (mother) was present in pro per as Guardian ad Litem for the minor Jia Pan Lin and Jia Da Lin, and and with Cantonese Interpreter: Jena Zhang.
Petitioner and Interpreter was placed under oath and examined.
Minor's father - Kangrong Lin was not present, but consented to the name change of the minor by way of declaration presented in open court.
Proof of Publication is in the file.
No objections to the proposed change of names were made at the hearing.
It appears to the satisfaction of the Court that all the allegations in the petition are true, correct and sufficient, and that the petition should be granted.

The Court grants the petition for Change of Name of the Minors to Emily Kiapan Lin and Norman Jiada Lin.
Decree Changing Name was submitted to and signed by the Court.
